items.acceptance_seed: Per repo: install transcript, config hash, tick envelope; adapter fixture + receipt envelope + verify output for the non-OMP worker; ledger row + verify output per refusal.

items.title: R9 milestone: a foreign repo reaches a graded close with no hand-edit under .omp-orchestrator/ (kill condition)
items.what: The section's terminal condition and its own kill condition: if a foreign repo cannot reach a graded close without hand-editing adapter state, the adapter boundary has failed.
items.acceptance_seed: On a repo and machine not ours: init -> tick ... -> grade CLOSED_WITH_EVIDENCE with `git status .omp-orchestrator/` showing only tool-written files; a hand edit under .omp-orchestrator/ during the run reopens this item.

existing_beads.evidence: an external-repo first-tick receipt proves the real entry path, and an independent grader confirms both

items.gap: Epic acceptance names first-tick only; graded close and the zero-hand-edit kill condition are unbeaded.
items.notes: Terminal for this section; parent jplf.7.

items.title: Cold start on a second machine: install, doctor, init, first tick with no sibling checkout or control-plane
items.what: R9's 'another machine' half: the binary installs and runs on a host that has neither this checkout nor control-plane; the M6 cold-host proof of §09.
items.acceptance_seed: On a clean host: cargo install (08.11) -> doctor --json exit 0 -> init -> tick --once exit 0, with OMP_CONTROL_PLANE_ROOT unset and no ../control-plane; receipts committed; a run that reads any /Users/josh or CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR path is RED.

existing_beads.evidence: self-contained is not the same as portable — M6 cold-host proof (§09) is a separate milestone this bead unblocks rather than satisfies
a clean-machine receipt proves installation
cargo test --workspace on a clean clone of HEAD FAILS unless a sibling directory named control-plane exists
Clean clone HEAD 7e6b70a: 23 tests fail on tree-stale workspace metadata drift

items.title: Add `why <unit>`: explain a unit's refusal from its ledger rows
items.what: The remediation named inside CLOSE_REFUSED_NO_EVIDENCE: a read-only command that prints, from ledger.jsonl, why a unit cannot close (missing artifact diff, missing gate result, withheld dispatch).
items.acceptance_seed: why TA-2 after a refused grade -> lists the refusal code, the run_id, and the two missing evidence kinds; on a unit with no rows -> typed UNIT_UNKNOWN, exit 2.

items.title: Writing-contract rules: a not-found must name command + search space; cite constructs, not lines
items.what: Two rules earned by the false-zero (`grep --include='*.rs'` over a Go repo): a published absence names the command and why the search space was right; a citation names the construct because four line cites drifted by one while every construct held.
items.acceptance_seed: plan_citations_name_constructs green over 08; a lint refuses a 'no prior art' claim in docs/plan without a pasted command and a binary/version (phcz); mutation: plant a bare line cite -> RED.

existing_beads.evidence: plus a lint that refuses new ones ... `cargo test -p no-shell-gate -- plan_citations_name_constructs`
grep is not one program in this fleet: a pattern-syntax claim must name its binary and version

items.gap: Construct-cite rule is covered by d1n; the 'not-found must name its search space' rule has only phcz's binary/version half, no search-space half.
